newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian beauty's praise for euro wins her crown.
newsitem.headline: Belgian beauty's praise for euro wins her crown.

text.p: A 19-year-old Belgian economics student carried off the crown in a beauty contest thanks to a speech on the merits of a single European currency, the Belgian newspaper Vers L'Avenir reported on Monday.
Miss Brabant Wallon, Sandrine Durant, now gets a chance to compete in the 1997 Miss Belgium contest, the newspaper said.
